verdict.line: You lose if you stand still through her Skip 'n Slash on-hit burst; you win if you poke from outside 450 range and punish every window her E or early-rank Needlework is down.

brief.thesis: Jayce's Cannon-stance kit is entirely ranged (Shock Blast at 600 range) while Gwen is a melee champion with exactly one short dash, Skip 'n Slash (400 range, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown), as her only way to close that gap. Every second her E is on cooldown, she has no answer to Jayce's poke and has to either eat damage or hide in Hallowed Mist doing nothing. The data backs this up: Jayce holds the lane and solo-kill edge, even if the raw head-to-head win rate (47.9% over 877 games) says the overall shape is close.

theirWindow.what: She can dash 400 units into you, gaining attack speed, range, and bonus magic damage on-hit for a few seconds, refunding the cooldown if she connects. Don't trade autos through this window in Hammer stance melee range — disengage with Cannon stance mobility until it expires.

yourWindow.what: She has zero gap close for up to 13 seconds. Walk up and poke freely with Shock Blast, or swap to Hammer stance and leap in with Q for a forced trade she can't dodge.

start.why: 96.2% pick rate at 47.4% win over 980 games — the sustain and early AD trade into her A Thousand Cuts poke.

boots.why: Most-picked boots (45.8%, 424 games) — the ability haste shortens Thundering Blow and Acceleration Gate cooldowns, both of which gate how often you can punish her E window.

core.why: Mana scaling for a mana-hungry poke kit, feeds directly into Muramana.
Active haste lets you reset Cannon-stance kiting speed right as her E dash resolves.
Core damage spike on Shock Blast pokes once Tear is banked — 48.4% win over 157 games on this exact path.
Highest pick rate 4th item (22.2%) — the slow-on-proc punishes her for closing distance with E.

situational.when: she's building tanky and you need the armor shred plus slow to stop her from resetting range after E
you want a cooldown-gated shield and burst proc for all-ins right after her E is spent
her team is stacking shields that are blunting your poke damage before it lands
her passive's magic damage ticks are chunking you faster than Ionian Boots lets you punish

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers a movement speed burst after using 3 different abilities — stacks on top of your stance-swap passive move speed, so right after you poke with Q and E-gate you're already sprinting away before her Skip 'n Slash window opens.

summoners.why: Most-run combo at 48.1% win and 51.1% pick. Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into real early kills once you catch her outside Hallowed Mist with her E down.

playing.title: Poke from Cannon stance range
playing.detail: Fire Shock Blast at 600 range whenever she's outside Hallowed Mist. Her Q (Snip Snip!) only reaches 450, so she physically cannot answer this poke.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown, not her health
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash is 13 seconds at rank 1, dropping to 11 at rank 5. Every second it's down is a second she has no gap close — step up and punish it.

playing.title: Never auto through her E burst
playing.detail: After she dashes in with E, she gets bonus attack speed, range, and on-hit magic damage for a few seconds and refunds the cooldown on a hit. Disengage immediately instead of trading autos.

playing.title: Extend pokes through your own gate
playing.detail: Deploy Acceleration Gate (Cannon E) and fire Shock Blast through it for increased missile speed, range, and damage — a way to poke her from even further outside her threat range.

playing.title: Abuse her low-rank ultimate
playing.detail: Needlework is 120/100/80 seconds at ranks 1-3. For most of the laning phase she has no third-cast slow to peel a gank — call your jungler in with confidence.

playing.title: Transform before committing to a trade
playing.detail: Swap stance with R right before an extended fight: the first hit after transforming shreds armor/MR in Cannon or adds bonus magic damage in Hammer, swinging a close trade your way.

playing.title: Don't fight inside her Mist
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist (22-18s cooldown) makes her untargetable to anyone standing outside it. If she tries to pull the fight into it, back out rather than following in — you give up your only advantage, range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the power-curve breakdown and trade-pattern reading are my own analysis of the ability kits, not measured data.
